messages:
maya: Intake: bringing up Astra-14B-lite for priority review. Short summary: 14B variant optimized for low-latency QA & embeddings, 16k context support claimed by upstream. Request: prioritization + slot for quant/bring-up next week. Key risks: hallucination on long context, unknown perf at 8k+ and quant degradation.

triage-bot: Label: intake/needs-priority-review · Status: unassigned

sri: Quick q — KV cache for >8k already integrated?

maya: yes, supports KV-cache and 16k configs, but we have no perf numbers beyond 8k.

ben: Initial quick score (proposal): product_fit:7, infra_cost:5, latency_gain:8, risk:6 -> total 26/40.

ben: Scoring rubric I used:
```
product_fit: 0-10 (higher = more product impact)
infra_cost: 0-10 (higher = more expensive)
latency_gain: 0-10 (higher = better latency improvement)
risk: 0-10 (higher = greater risk)
```

oliver: Can we reuse the Zephyr-lite INT8 profile? saves ops.

maya: probably yes for a baseline. Plan is: bf16 -> per-op INT8 dynamic quant, with per-op int16 fallback if quality drops. Need to validate kernel coverage.

eva: I'll take perf benching & latency microbench. Can run against both 8k and 16k sequences.

maya: thanks @eva. eva, can you also capture memory usage and tail latency p95/p99?

eva: yep. ETA: 48h after I get the model artifact.

oliver: I'll run quant compatibility pass and report ops that require fallback.

maya: @sri can you try to reserve a bring-up slot in window B next Tue/Wed? SRE capacity looks tight.

sri: putting a tentative slot for 2026-04-12 09:00-12:00 UTC (window B). Will confirm by EOD.

ben: small ask — can we gate by quality regression thresholds? propose: no more than 2% absolute drop on our QA devset and <1% drop on embeddings recall. If exceeded, fallback to int16 or reduce quant aggressiveness.

maya: agreed. add to rollout policy.

triage-bot: Action created: /intake/Astra-14B-lite -> owners: eva, oliver, sri; due: 2923540000

maya: Action items recap: 1) eva: perf bench + p95/p99 + memory (48h) 2) oliver: quant compatibility + fallback matrix (48h) 3) sri: lock bring-up slot (EOD) 4) ben: finalize priority score in prioritization sheet <https://go/reports/prio-sheet> 5) maya: prepare eval prompt-set & long-context tests.

ben: :thumbsup:

maya: If anyone sees big red flags in the benches, post here and we'll move to canary-only rollout. Otherwise we'll target canary -> A/B -> global within 2 weeks of successful perf/quality smoke.

oliver: noted. I'll list unsupported kernels if any and propose mitigations.

maya: thanks all — ping me if you need model artifacts or keys.

sri: will confirm slot and update ticket.

maya: closing intake for now, will reopen with bench results. :rocket:
